extra.message: User-supplied 'username' from the POST request body is concatenated directly into a SQL query string via an f-string and passed to cur.execute(). An attacker can inject arbitrary SQL (e.g. username=' OR '1'='1) to bypass authentication, read, or modify data. This endpoint is exposed via swagger.yml as POST /sqlivuln.

cwe: CWE-89: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an SQL Command ('SQL Injection')

extra.message: User-supplied 'mathexp' from the POST request body is concatenated into a Jinja2 Template and rendered with test.render(). This allows Server-Side Template Injection, leading to arbitrary code execution (e.g. {{ ''.__class__.__mro__[1].__subclasses__() }} or os access). Exposed via swagger.yml as POST /sstivuln.

cwe: CWE-94: Improper Control of Generation of Code ('Code Injection')

extra.message: User-supplied 'imagelink' from the POST request body (passed as 'name') is used directly as the URL in requests.get(). An attacker can force the server to make arbitrary requests to internal/external hosts (SSRF), including cloud metadata endpoints or file:// schemes. TLS verification is also disabled (verify=False). Exposed via swagger.yml as POST /rfivuln.

User-supplied 'filename' from the POST request body (passed as 'name') is used directly in open() with no sanitization or path validation. An attacker can supply an absolute path or '../' sequences to read arbitrary files on the server (e.g. /etc/passwd). Exposed via swagger.yml as POST /lfivuln.

cwe: CWE-22: Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal')

extra.message: User-supplied 'username' from the request body is reflected back unescaped in the response message. If rendered in an HTML context by a client, this enables reflected Cross-Site Scripting. Exposed via swagger.yml as POST /xssreflected.

cwe: CWE-79: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')

extra.message: The attacker-controlled 'Host' HTTP header is read from request.headers and reflected unescaped into an HTML anchor href in the response. This enables Host Header Injection and reflected XSS (the value is placed inside an href attribute without sanitization), commonly leading to password-reset poisoning and link manipulation. Exposed via swagger.yml as POST /hhivuln.

cwe: CWE-644: Improper Neutralization of HTTP Headers for Scripting Syntax

extra.message: Flask is run with debug=True and bound to 0.0.0.0. Debug mode enables the Werkzeug interactive debugger, which exposes a console that can execute arbitrary Python code (remote code execution) and leaks stack traces with source code. Binding to 0.0.0.0 exposes the debug interface to the network.

Hardcoded user credentials (admin/admin) are inserted into the USERS table. Default/weak hardcoded credentials allow trivial authentication and are a security risk. A second hardcoded credential pair (mike/kaines) exists on line 25.

Raw exception details (the SQL/database error message) are returned to the client in the response body. This leaks internal error information that aids SQL injection exploitation and discloses database structure.

cwe: CWE-209: Generation of Error Message Containing Sensitive Information
